item.title: Version 1.1.16
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.16

  • Redesigned News Cards & Grid: Modern card layout with responsive columns, clean publisher badges, publication timestamps, and category tabs (All, Portfolios, Watchlists).
  • AI News Auto-Translation: Seamlessly translate international financial news headlines and articles into your preferred language using AI, with automatic quota detection and status badges.
  • Optimized Reader Mode: Reading column width refined to an ergonomic 680pt reading width, distraction-free typography, and instant toggle between translated and original text.
  • Enhanced Yahoo Finance Crawler: Full article extraction using modern DOM containers, stripping ticker tape badge clutter, and automatic detection of syndicated partner articles with paywall notices.
  • Comprehensive Localization: Added complete translations across all 8 supported languages for all news reader and translation features.
